title: Slaanesh Expanded - Corruption & Confederation
author: Narok-
description:
Summary:

This mod introduces short event chains that trigger when the player defeats one of the female Legendary Lords (LL). There are three event levels per LL. The purpose of this mod is to add an in-game friendly way to give traits that apply Slaanesh Corruption to the LL's that offset their natural anti-corruption mechanics.

There is also an optional confederation submod. Both mods are required for the confederation function to work correctly.

Note: This mod is intended to be used with a Slaanesh faction, but by popular demand it will work with any faction. Including the female lords.

Key Features:

Triggering the Events:

-
Defeat one of the female LL's with any army belonging to your faction.

-
It should work with played and auto-resolve battles.

-
If you make one of the LL's a vassal or confederate them then the events will progress at the start of every turn. The event text is different than if you have defeated the lord in battle, but more basic. Defeating the LL's is the intended mechanic.

-
There is no cooldown.

Trait Info:

-
All traits apply increased Slaanesh corruption to the defeated LL, with the amount increasing every level.

-
The corruption amount is tailored for each LL.

-
At level 3, you have the option to apply or decline a "Harem" trait. The bonus applies a faction-wide Slaanesh corruption & a diplomatic relations buff between all supported factions. The bonuses are balanced around the LL remaining a vassal.

-
Some lords have additional unique traits, such as Alarielle to offset her 'Power of Nature' or Miao Yings faction-wide -2 corruption.

Supported Factions:

-
Alarielle

-
Elspeth

-
Fay Enchantress

-
Hellebron

-
Katarin

-
Miao Ying

-
Morathi

-
Repanse

-
Sisters of Twilight

-
Khalida

Confederation Submod:

-
Requires the core mod to work.

-
Adds a background counter for each lord. Every victory in battle adds one point. Once they are made a vassal they will also gain one point per turn.

-
If the specific legendary lord is a vassal, and you have eight or more points you will be prompted to confederate them or leave them as a vassal.

Compatibility:

-
Currently the defeat events won't trigger on characters that use multiple corruption stages, such as Lazy's Miao or Kat. However, the subjugation events will still trigger if either of those two are made vassals/confederated. I may eventually fix this conflict in the future.

Additional info:

-

-
Additional Feedback/suggestions are welcome! If anyone finds any bugs or has recommendations, feel free to leave a comment!
changelog_latest:
Victories

- Added new vassalized fluff text to be more narrative.

- Changed the Harem diplomacy buff from 66->150. I underestimated just how much some of them hate each other. I'm looking at you, Alarielle the intolerant.

- Fixed some Khalida's text typos.

- Fixed an error with Maio's unique Harem trait.

Confederation

- Added a feature to delay the confederation decision by 5 turns.

- Changed the points needed for the confederation dilemma from 6->8. Essentially this means it will take two turns longer for the dilemma to appear.

- Fixed some Khalida's & the Sisters confederation event text typos.

- Fixed a conflict with the main mod which was preventing description text from showing.
